query:
UPDATE web_push_subscriptions
           SET endpoint = $2,
               key_p256dh = $3,
               key_auth = $4,
               data = $5,
               standard = $6,
               user_id = $7,
               updated_at = now()
           WHERE access_token_id = $1
           RETURNING id, standard, data as "data: serde_json::Value"
